title: 토지개발 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Registrations to Be Applied For)
(1) Where land registers have been rearranged following cadastral confirmation surveys upon completion of a land development project and an official notice of final implementation has been issued, the registered owner of the relevant land shall simultaneously apply for the following registrations:
1. Cancellation of registration concerning the former land;
2. Preservation of ownership registration concerning newly developed land.
(2) Where the registration records of the former land contain a registration falling under any subparagraph of Article 2 (2), an application for such registration shall be filed simultaneously with the application under paragraph (1).
(3) In cases under paragraph (2), registrations falling under Article 2 (2) 1 or 2 shall be applied for solely by the registered owner of the land, whereas registrations falling under Article 2 (2) 3 or 4 shall be applied for jointly by the registered owner of the land and the registered holder of the relevant right.
